description: Legacy owner-wallet return workflow, still under certification; it may stop at an intermediate owner wallet. For allocated Hyperliquid, Lighter or Polymarket capital returning to Arc Home, use preview_capital_move then start_capital_move(direction=bring_home), and get_capital_move for reconciliation. Retain the original ID, key and hashes for an interrupted legacy operation; never use a new key to bypass an uncertain result.

allow_high_fee_loss.description: Crypto only: accept a high proportional route cost if the selected provider requires it. Never enabled by default.

amount_usd.description: Amount to return. Omit to sweep the full spendable prediction-market balance.

idempotency_key.description: Required workflow replay key. Reuse it after any timeout or restart.

resume_reconciliation.description: Crypto only: with a fresh workflow key, resume a prior confirmed venue withdrawal only when the owner-held Arbitrum balance matches the bounded post-fee amount.

name: bring_home
